entry_surfaces./: Branded Violet-Blue auth portal: Lumiq brandmark and Google SSO trigger card centered over geometric glowing grid, with dynamic loading state ('Iniciando...'), seamless redirection to full admin panel or limited non-admin user view.

visual_enhancers.theme: Violeta Azul (Deep Violet-Blue Dark Mode with energetic Indigo/Violet glow accents)
visual_enhancers.aesthetic: Tactical modern dashboard with 1px luminescent borders, crisp pill badges, and elevated glass cards
visual_enhancers.code_cards: Distinct 6-digit display with high-contrast mono font, instant 1-click clipboard copy feedback, and dedicated WhatsApp click-to-chat action generator (wa.me/numero?text=...)

grids_and_layouts.layout_mode: Sidebar + Header + Dynamic Main Content area with high density scanability
grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Fixed 260px desktop collapsible sidebar with quick navigation across: 'Dashboard General', 'Códigos de 6 Dígitos', 'Usuarios', 'Roles', 'Números', 'Celulares', 'Dispositivos', 'Configuración de Supabase / RPCs'
grids_and_layouts.code_grid: Responsive grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-5 with prominent OTP code preview, phone assignment, retry counter (intentos), and WhatsApp action button
grids_and_layouts.tables_layout: Full width responsive data tables with searchable filters, status chips, pagination, inline CRUD modals, and role selector RPC triggers

motion.transitions: transition: background-color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease, transform 0.18s ease, opacity 0.18s ease
motion.loading_pulse: Smooth subtle pulsing glowing ring for 'Iniciando...' state and RPC execution feedback

accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 text to background contrast on all surfaces)
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive inputs, Google auth button, tabs, modals, copy buttons, and WhatsApp buttons must include data-testid in kebab-case
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring outline: ring-2 ring-[#818CF8] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0B0D17]

key_components.name: Auth & Registration Screen
key_components.description: Initial screen featuring Google sign-in trigger, loading state 'Iniciando...', account verification check, and conditional registration modal asking for mandatory fields (nombre, numero) + optional admin details (apellido, fecha_nacimiento, genero, ubicacion, foto_perfil).

key_components.name: 6-Digit Codes Manager ('Códigos')
key_components.description: Dedicated view displaying generated 6-digit verification codes, associated phone numbers, status (Activo, Expirado, Usado), retry attempts count, quick Copy Code button, and 'Enviar por WhatsApp' direct link button with pre-filled message.

key_components.name: Admin Data Tables (Supabase Schema)
key_components.description: Tabbed management for 'usuarios', 'roles', 'numero', 'celular', and 'dispositivos', supporting CRUD actions and Supabase RPC triggers (crear_mi_usuario, obtener_mi_usuario, admin_ver_codigo, admin_cambiar_rol).

key_components.name: Non-Admin Limited View
key_components.description: Restricted dashboard for regular users allowing profile viewing and personal code status without administrative CRUD permissions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-performance, polished administration app supporting the LumiqAdmin requirements in Spanish.
Deliver the core interactive web application with the Violeta Azul palette (#0B0D17 base, #12172A panels, #6366F1 accent) matching the design token specs.
Implement the authentication workflow: Google login button -> 'Iniciando...' state -> account existence verification -> registration if not found (with nombre and numero as required fields).

Implement the 'Códigos' view featuring 6-digit OTP cards with phone number link, estado badge, intentos counter, instant clipboard copy action with toast notification, and WhatsApp direct messaging button (wa.me/numero?text=Su%20c%C3%B3digo%20de%20verificaci%C3%B3n%20es%3A%20XXXXXX).

Provide tables and views for all requested Supabase collections/tables: usuarios, roles, numero, celular, dispositivos, along with simulated/configured RPC handlers for crear_mi_usuario, obtener_mi_usuario, admin_ver_codigo, and admin_cambiar_rol.
Support a mock/configured Supabase credentials bar/modal where the user can inspect or insert their own Supabase URL & API key dynamically.
Ensure non-admin users entering have an appropriate limited view banner and restricted action permissions.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, tabs, inputs, and cards for end-to-end testing stability.
